title: FrameShift
description: Rotate items in frames backwards by holding Shift! A simple and essential QoL improvement.
body:
Have you ever accidentally clicked an item in a frame one too many times and had to click seven more times just to get it back? FrameShift is a lightweight, vanilla-style utility mod that fixes this minor but constant frustration!

This mod adds a simple, intuitive mechanic: you can now rotate items in frames backwards. No more endless clicking to fix a frame's orientation.

🕹️ How it works:
Right-Click: Rotates the item clockwise (Vanilla behavior).

Shift + Right-Click: Rotates the item counter-clockwise (Backwards).

✨ Key Features:
Reverse Rotation: Quickly fix item positions with a single click.

Builder Friendly: Makes detailed interior decoration much faster and less annoying.

Redstone Compatible: Fully updates comparators, making it perfect for shops and hidden doors.

Mod Compatibility: Works with most modded frames (like Quark) that extend the vanilla frame class.

Extremely Lightweight: Zero impact on your FPS or server performance.

🛠️ Technical Details:
Server/Client: This mod is Required on the Server. It is highly recommended to have it on the Client as well for smooth animations and sound.
